prompt: Two notes have the same pitch, but one sounds much louder than the other. What differs between the two sound waves?

options.text: The louder wave has a lower frequency
The louder wave travels much faster
The louder wave has a larger amplitude
The louder wave has a longer wavelength only

explanation: Loudness is linked to amplitude — the size of the vibration. Bigger pressure swings carry more energy and are heard as a louder sound at the same pitch.
